mcpTools.name: activate_project_core
mcpTools.description: Activate canonical issue access only after confirmed current readiness. Project administrator required; retained data, old receipts and independent board ranks remain unchanged.

mcpTools.name: add_dependency
mcpTools.description: Add a same-project blocker using current issue/graph revisions. Duplicate links are no-ops; cycles include parent/subtask edges.

mcpTools.name: append_asset_chunk
mcpTools.description: Append canonical base64 of at most 1 MiB at the exact received offset. Nonfinal chunks are multiples of 256 KiB. Retry identical content with its original reference.

mcpTools.name: approve_user
mcpTools.description: Approve a company account; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: archive_board
mcpTools.description: Archive a named view while preserving its issues and settings; the default board cannot archive.

mcpTools.name: archive_project
mcpTools.description: Archive a project while retaining its content, history and memberships; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: backfill_field_defaults
mcpTools.description: BackfillField: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: cancel_asset_upload
mcpTools.description: Cancel your unfinished private upload; published assets cannot be canceled.

mcpTools.name: create_board
mcpTools.description: Create a named view in an active project without copying or changing issues.

mcpTools.name: create_board_v2
mcpTools.description: Create an independent named board using the default stage mappings without copying issue ranks.

mcpTools.name: create_comment
mcpTools.description: Add an Arabic or mixed-language formatted comment, explicit selected mentions and at most five same-issue pictures. Unsupported HTML is sanitized with notices; completed drafts publish atomically. Retry the same intention with its original reference.

mcpTools.name: create_issue
mcpTools.description: Create a Task or Bug in an active project; defaults are Todo, Task and Medium. Attribution is the current caller.

mcpTools.name: create_issue_v2
mcpTools.description: Create standard or subtask work with typed choice identifiers. Omitted choices resolve under the project guard; retry preserves the originally accepted defaults.

mcpTools.name: create_label
mcpTools.description: Create or reuse a project label. Names differing only in Unicode letter case retain the existing identity and display text.

mcpTools.name: create_planning_item
mcpTools.description: Create an epic or release in a writable project, with a UUID retry reference.

mcpTools.name: create_project
mcpTools.description: Create a company project and its default All Issues Kanban board; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: create_subtask
mcpTools.description: Create independent child work under a current non-Done Task or Bug. Parent identity and Subtask type stay fixed; completion remains explicit and guarded.

mcpTools.name: detach_asset
mcpTools.description: Detach from the issue panel while retaining historical references and bytes.

mcpTools.name: detach_attachment
mcpTools.description: Detach a document using the current issue revision. Immutable bytes and audit history remain available to current authorized project readers.

mcpTools.name: detach_gallery_picture
mcpTools.description: Remove a published picture from the current gallery using the current issue revision. Immutable bytes and all old comment references remain available to authorized readers.

mcpTools.name: download_asset_chunk
mcpTools.description: Download at most 1 MiB of private asset bytes with current access checks before and after storage I/O. Do not repeat bytes in prose.

mcpTools.name: download_attachment
mcpTools.description: Download one currently authorized attachment as one base64 field plus metadata. No public or signed URL; do not repeat the bytes in prose.

mcpTools.name: download_picture
mcpTools.description: Download one currently authorized picture as one base64 field plus metadata. No public or signed URL; do not repeat the bytes in prose.

mcpTools.name: export_issues
mcpTools.description: Export one authorized filtered project page as UTF-8 CSV with formula-safe cells. Continue using nextCursor; reduce limit for oversized descriptions.

mcpTools.name: finalize_asset_upload
mcpTools.description: Verify completed size, SHA-256 and content before committing one private draft or issue attachment.

mcpTools.name: get_asset
mcpTools.description: Read currently authorized published or own private asset metadata.

mcpTools.name: get_asset_policy
mcpTools.description: Read the configured file/image and chunk limits.

mcpTools.name: get_asset_upload
mcpTools.description: Read current progress of your own recoverable upload.

mcpTools.name: get_attachment
mcpTools.description: Read protected immutable attachment metadata using current project read access.

mcpTools.name: get_board
mcpTools.description: Read four column counts. Temporary filters narrow visible counts; saved WIP counts remain complete.

mcpTools.name: get_board_v2
mcpTools.description: Read independent columns, workflow stage mappings and full saved-view counts.

mcpTools.name: get_inbox_summary
mcpTools.description: Read your current accessible unread count and company calendar date. Other users and revoked projects are excluded.

mcpTools.name: get_issue
mcpTools.description: Read an accessible issue, current capabilities and graph/order revisions.

mcpTools.name: get_issue_approvals
mcpTools.description: GetApprovals: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: get_issue_fields
mcpTools.description: GetCustomFields: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: get_issue_planning
mcpTools.description: Read epic and release assignments with their own revision.

mcpTools.name: get_issue_v2
mcpTools.description: Read canonical issue type, priority, workflow and stage identities with current display names and capabilities.

mcpTools.name: get_kanban_report
mcpTools.description: Read a UTC-window Kanban report from actual status history and a current aging/blocked snapshot.

mcpTools.name: get_me
mcpTools.description: Read your own approved company identity and calendar.

mcpTools.name: get_notification
mcpTools.description: Read one of your notifications without changing its read state. Unknown, foreign and inaccessible notifications share an unavailable outcome.

mcpTools.name: get_notification_preferences
mcpTools.description: Read your own notification event, inbox, email and due-reminder preferences. Email availability reflects deployment configuration.

mcpTools.name: get_picture
mcpTools.description: Read protected picture metadata. Unexpired comment drafts are visible only to their uploader with current project access.

mcpTools.name: get_project
mcpTools.description: Read an accessible project and your current effective role.

mcpTools.name: get_project_activation
mcpTools.description: Review current project readiness and revisions before administrator activation of canonical issue access.

mcpTools.name: get_project_configuration
mcpTools.description: Read project-scoped configuration, capabilities and current creation defaults.

mcpTools.name: get_transition_policy
mcpTools.description: GetTransitionPolicy: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: import_issues
mcpTools.description: Import valid CSV rows after preview. Retain batchId and retryReference on retries; stable source keys deduplicate across batches. Per-row errors preserve successful rows.

mcpTools.name: list_activity
mcpTools.description: Read paginated history: company history requires Administrator; an exact issue resourceKind/resourceId allows current project readers. Read retained activity history with retained human attribution and relevant changes. Resource filters require kind and ID together; personal inbox content is private.

mcpTools.name: list_assets
mcpTools.description: List unified issue attachments with scoped cursor pagination.

mcpTools.name: list_assignees
mcpTools.description: List minimal eligible project assignee summaries.

mcpTools.name: list_attachments
mcpTools.description: List currently attached documents with bounded cursor pagination. Detached documents remain downloadable by ID with current project access.

mcpTools.name: list_automation_rules
mcpTools.description: List a project's stage-entry assignment rules, including disabled rules.

mcpTools.name: list_backlog
mcpTools.description: Read planned work in independent project backlog rank order. Ordering cursors expire when planning order changes.

mcpTools.name: list_board_cards
mcpTools.description: Read one bounded column page in shared project order; reload after an invalidated cursor.

mcpTools.name: list_board_cards_v2
mcpTools.description: Read a ranked-then-unranked column page with explicit terminal state and scoped cursors.

mcpTools.name: list_boards
mcpTools.description: List a project's named and default boards with current management capabilities.

mcpTools.name: list_comment_versions
mcpTools.description: Read retained immutable comment versions, oldest first. Picture IDs require authenticated downloads.

mcpTools.name: list_comments
mcpTools.description: Read the issue's paginated oldest-first discussion with canonical HTML, plain text and protected picture IDs.

mcpTools.name: list_dependencies
mcpTools.description: Read Blocked By or Blocks with responsible developers, statuses and bounded reciprocal summaries. Reload after a graph cursor changes.

mcpTools.name: list_development_links
mcpTools.description: List manually linked pull requests, commits and other development URLs for an accessible issue.

mcpTools.name: list_field_options
mcpTools.description: FieldOptions: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: list_fields
mcpTools.description: Fields: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: list_issue_transitions_v2
mcpTools.description: Page through active target stages in the issue's current workflow, including current permission and review requirements.

mcpTools.name: list_issue_types
mcpTools.description: List active or retained project issue types with checked behavior.

mcpTools.name: list_labels
mcpTools.description: Find reusable labels in an accessible project, with bounded portions and Unicode casefold search.

mcpTools.name: list_membership_candidates
mcpTools.description: List minimal approved company directory names for membership management in your authorized project.

mcpTools.name: list_memberships
mcpTools.description: List project memberships; company Administrator or authorized project administrator with Configure access.

mcpTools.name: list_mention_candidates
mcpTools.description: List minimal eligible project reader summaries for selected mentions.

mcpTools.name: list_notifications
mcpTools.description: Read your private newest-first inbox, with bounded cursor pages and an optional unread-only filter. Only currently accessible projects are included.

mcpTools.name: list_pictures
mcpTools.description: List current gallery pictures and optionally only your own unexpired private drafts. Inline pictures retained in comments remain downloadable by ID.

mcpTools.name: list_planning_issues
mcpTools.description: Page through issues assigned to a project epic or release.

mcpTools.name: list_planning_items
mcpTools.description: List accessible epics or releases with target dates and progress.

mcpTools.name: list_priorities
mcpTools.description: List project priorities with precise positive ordering and retirement state.

mcpTools.name: list_projects
mcpTools.description: List your accessible projects; archived projects are optional.

mcpTools.name: list_saved_searches
mcpTools.description: List the caller's private saved searches (maximum 50).

mcpTools.name: list_subtasks
mcpTools.description: Read one-level child work in issue-number order, with independent fields and bounded portions.

mcpTools.name: list_type_workflow_bindings
mcpTools.description: Read retained allowed/default workflows for one project issue type.

mcpTools.name: list_users
mcpTools.description: List approved company accounts; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: list_workflow_stages
mcpTools.description: Page through ordered workflow stages and their entry/retirement state.

mcpTools.name: list_workflow_transitions
mcpTools.description: Page through explicit directed workflow moves and required project permission.

mcpTools.name: list_workflows
mcpTools.description: Page through project workflows, retaining retired workflow identities for existing issues.

mcpTools.name: mark_all_notifications_read
mcpTools.description: Mark your currently accessible inbox snapshot read, returning only your changed count and summary. No recipient override, sending or notification loop is supported.

mcpTools.name: migrate_workflow_issues
mcpTools.description: Atomically migrate a batch of up to 100 issues from a closed stage to a same-category stage in an allowed workflow. Preserve issue history, notices and retry identity.

mcpTools.name: move_board_card_v2
mcpTools.description: Move a board card with current issue, layout and column revisions. Supply an explicit stage for ambiguous grouped destinations.

mcpTools.name: move_issue
mcpTools.description: Move using fresh issue, source/target order and optional board revisions. Done requires completed blockers and children. WIP warns only; append in the target column.

mcpTools.name: move_issue_v2
mcpTools.description: Move within the issue's assigned canonical workflow, enforcing current transition permission, stage intake, blockers and subtask completion.

mcpTools.name: organize_issue
mcpTools.description: Archive/restore or plan an issue in the backlog with its current revision. Archive hides active work without deleting history or changing completion.

mcpTools.name: patch_issue_field
mcpTools.description: Change only assignee, priority or due date using that field's prior value. Unrelated edits are preserved; stale selected values conflict. Explicit null clears assignee/date; unchanged values do not create a change event.

mcpTools.name: patch_issue_field_v2
mcpTools.description: Save one selected assignee, priority identifier or date by prior-value CAS; unrelated field edits merge and unchanged saves are no-ops.

mcpTools.name: preview_issue_import
mcpTools.description: Validate and preview up to100 mapped CSV rows without writing issues. Names/emails/IDs must match a unique eligible assignee; labels use semicolons.

mcpTools.name: remove_dependency
mcpTools.description: Remove a blocker with fresh issue, graph and relationship revisions. Retain the relationship and activity history.

mcpTools.name: remove_membership
mcpTools.description: Remove current project membership and clear ineligible assignments.

mcpTools.name: reorder_backlog
mcpTools.description: Rank planned work before or after another backlog item using current issue and backlog order revisions. Active column order is unchanged.

mcpTools.name: reorder_board_card_v2
mcpTools.description: Change this board's card order in the same column without editing issue content or other boards.

mcpTools.name: reorder_issue
mcpTools.description: Move before or after one actual same-column neighbor, preserving hidden cards and shared project order.

mcpTools.name: restore_board
mcpTools.description: Restore a named view with its retained settings.

mcpTools.name: restore_project
mcpTools.description: Restore an archived project and its retained work; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: resubmit_issue_approval
mcpTools.description: ResubmitApproval: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: save_automation_rule
mcpTools.description: Administrator only: create or edit a rule assigning work when it enters a registered stage. At most one enabled rule per stage.

mcpTools.name: save_board_layout_v2
mcpTools.description: Save column grouping, names, order and warning/hard limits. Keep default-board coverage and full-view hard capacity valid.

mcpTools.name: save_development_link
mcpTools.description: Create, edit or detach a validated development URL at the current revision using a stable link UUID and retry reference.

mcpTools.name: save_field
mcpTools.description: SaveField: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: save_field_option
mcpTools.description: SaveFieldOption: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: save_issue_fields
mcpTools.description: SaveCustomFields: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: save_issue_search
mcpTools.description: Create, replace or remove a private saved search. Use expectedRevision 0 only for a new caller-generated UUID; maximum 50 active searches.

mcpTools.name: save_issue_type
mcpTools.description: Create, rename or retire a project type at the current configuration revision. Project administrator required.

mcpTools.name: save_priority
mcpTools.description: Create, rename, order or retire a project priority at the current configuration revision. Project administrator required.

mcpTools.name: save_transition_policy
mcpTools.description: SaveTransitionPolicy: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.

mcpTools.name: save_workflow
mcpTools.description: Create, rename or retire a workflow at the current project configuration revision. Replacing defaults does not migrate existing work.

mcpTools.name: save_workflow_stage
mcpTools.description: Edit one workflow stage. Close intake, migrate issues, then retire the empty stage; preserve completion paths and default-board coverage.

mcpTools.name: save_workflow_transition
mcpTools.description: Edit a directed move between stages in one workflow while retaining required completion paths.

mcpTools.name: search_issues
mcpTools.description: Search accessible issues with AND filters and bounded pages; use assignee kind self for My Issues.

mcpTools.name: search_issues_v2
mcpTools.description: Search authorized issues by number/key/title and typed choice identifiers. Live pages preserve exact totals and precision-safe priority ordering.

mcpTools.name: set_issue_link
mcpTools.description: Add or remove a retained same-project relates-to or duplicates link. Use the current issue revision.

mcpTools.name: set_issue_planning
mcpTools.description: Assign or clear an issue epic and release from the same project at the planning revision.

mcpTools.name: set_issue_watch
mcpTools.description: Watch or unwatch an accessible issue for the authenticated caller. Subscription state is private.

mcpTools.name: set_membership
mcpTools.description: Grant or replace a project role using its retained revision.

mcpTools.name: set_notification_read
mcpTools.description: Set your notification read or unread using its current revision. Viewer access is sufficient for your own inbox. Retry the original reference after an uncertain response; this produces no further notifications.

mcpTools.name: set_project_defaults
mcpTools.description: Atomically replace active creation defaults for modern issue clients; existing work retains its references.

mcpTools.name: set_type_workflow_binding
mcpTools.description: Set a type/workflow binding and its creation default/intake. Existing issues keep their binding; modern issue access is required for changes.

mcpTools.name: start_asset_upload
mcpTools.description: Reserve a resumable upload with complete SHA-256, byte count and metadata. Session ID is actor scoped; storage capabilities stay private.

mcpTools.name: update_board
mcpTools.description: Replace current board settings with a fresh revision. WIP limits warn without blocking valid moves.

mcpTools.name: update_comment
mcpTools.description: Edit your own comment with its current revision and current project write access. Old versions and references are retained; newly added mentions require current access.

mcpTools.name: update_issue
mcpTools.description: Replace every editable field from a fresh issue read and revision. Use null to clear assignment/date; status, reporter and parent remain immutable.

mcpTools.name: update_issue_v2
mcpTools.description: Edit canonical issue fields at the current issue revision. Retain unchanged retired choices and preserve its assigned workflow.

mcpTools.name: update_notification_preferences
mcpTools.description: Save your notification preferences with current revision and retry reference. Applies to new events; email delivery requires a configured sender. Due reminders use your selected channels for assigned or reported issues due today.

mcpTools.name: update_planning_item
mcpTools.description: Update planning fields at the current revision; no duplicate side effects on replay.

mcpTools.name: update_project
mcpTools.description: Replace project name and description at its current revision; company Administrator or authorized project administrator with Configure access.

mcpTools.name: update_user
mcpTools.description: Replace current editable account fields; Administrator only.

mcpTools.name: upload_asset
mcpTools.description: Upload a validated image or file, up to 10 MiB, as canonical base64. Draft publication remains private until an owning comment is saved.

mcpTools.name: upload_attachment
mcpTools.description: Upload one PDF, UTF-8 TXT/CSV, DOCX or XLSX, maximum decoded 10 MiB, as canonical base64 with filename and matching MIME type. Original retry reference and identical bytes recover ambiguous transfers.

mcpTools.name: upload_picture
mcpTools.description: Upload one PNG, JPEG or WebP, maximum decoded 10 MiB, as canonical base64 with filename and meaningful description. Choose a private comment_draft or immediately published gallery picture. Original retry reference and identical bytes recover ambiguous transfers.

mcpTools.name: vote_issue_approval
mcpTools.description: VoteApproval: scoped typed values and current rule revisions; historical data retained.
